comment: Bridge export ratchet for the §5.4.4 outlet redesign per ADR-049 round 5/6. Each new export listed here is enforced as additive — entries can be added but never removed without explicit human approval. Pre-existing exports are tracked elsewhere; this baseline scopes only the SCP-OUT-041d-introduced surface.

wasm.comment: WASM-only helper — scp-runtime's GovernanceState::pinned_outlet_message_keys map is mirrored locally because WASM cannot depend on scp-runtime (tokio). Callers (typically the SDK receiver layer) pin the key here at outlet-registration acceptance time so outlet_error_new can compute the §5.4.4 HMAC at the FFI boundary.
